Good to know

Where is Atlanta Cuisine located?

Atlanta Cuisine is on the 2nd floor of T-Place Mall, above CleanShelf Supermarket, in Ongata Rongai, Kenya.

What time does Atlanta Cuisine open?

Atlanta Cuisine opens from 8:30 am to 8 pm Monday to Saturday and on holidays. Sunday hours are 11 am to 7:30 pm.

How can I order from Atlanta Cuisine?

Call 0722 283 154 or 0180 004 409 to place an order or ask about a dish.

What food is on the menu?

The menu includes beef biryani, beef curry, stir-fried beef, chicken and chips, whole tilapia wet fry, chips masala, milkshakes and mocktails. Prices are listed in Kenyan shillings (KSh).

How do I ask about allergies or dietary needs?

Tell the team about any allergies or dietary needs before ordering. Call 0722 283 154 to ask about ingredients in a dish.
